about: Catalogue of the live Blue Flame Games apps. Generated by tools/build_llms.py; coming-soon games are not listed.

apps.name: Tickview: SEC Filings & Alerts
apps.summary: Sourced alerts for your watchlist and the economy: new SEC filings, insider purchases, price crossings and Recession Watch (a model probability shown with its track record), plus the bond market and plain-English questions answered with sourced cards. Not investment advice.
apps.audience: Individual investors who want sourced information on iPhone and iPad rather than tips.
apps.priceModel: 7-day Pro trial, then a one-time purchase or a monthly subscription
apps.privacy: No account, no ads. All AI runs on the device; the app fetches only public market data.

apps.name: 11 Plus Exam Prep: Cognithix
apps.summary: 11+ practice for ages 9 to 11: English, verbal reasoning, non-verbal reasoning and language aptitude (no maths), with daily plans, timed mock papers and parent progress insights.
apps.audience: Parents preparing a child for the 11+ for grammar and independent schools in England.
apps.priceModel: 7-day free trial, then a one-time purchase
apps.privacy: No account; data stays on the device.

apps.name: Arithmetix - Times Tables SATs
apps.summary: UK National Curriculum maths from Reception to Year 6 with spaced repetition, times tables practice for the Year 4 multiplication check, and virtual pet motivation.
apps.audience: UK primary school children and their parents.
apps.priceModel: 7-day free trial, then a one-time purchase
apps.privacy: No account; progress stays on the device.

apps.name: Doodlebee: Coloring & Drawing
apps.summary: Drawing and coloring app for kids and grown-ups: draw any shape, tap to fill it and watch it dance, with pages to color by hand or by number, storybooks read aloud and music.
apps.audience: Children and families who want a calm, safe creative app.
apps.priceModel: Free download; one purchase unlocks everything for the whole family
apps.privacy: No ads, no accounts; nothing leaves the device.

apps.name: PhotoFlight: Travel Photo Map
apps.summary: Travel map built from the location data already in your photos: countries, cities, flights and achievements, with no live tracking needed. Includes PhotoGuessr, a family game where everyone secretly pins where one of your photos was taken.
apps.audience: Travellers who want a map of past trips from the photos they already have.
apps.priceModel: Free download; Pro is a one-time purchase
apps.privacy: No account; your travel history stays on the device.

apps.name: Ondi: Private Period Tracker
apps.summary: Private period and cycle diary with Apple Watch temperature support.
apps.audience: People who want to keep a cycle diary without an account or an Ondi server.
apps.priceModel: Free version; 7-day trial of everything, then a one-time purchase
apps.privacy: No accounts and no Ondi server; logs stay on the device.

apps.name: Cloudmesh: Rain Alerts & Radar
apps.summary: Hyperlocal weather: minute-by-minute rain alerts, live radar, a forecast blended from many sources, air quality and 24 widgets.
apps.audience: Anyone who wants accurate rain timing and a weather app without a subscription.
apps.priceModel: Free version; 7-day trial of everything, then a one-time purchase
apps.privacy: No account; approximate location is used for forecasts and rain alerts.

apps.name: PaceGrid: GPS Running Tracker
apps.summary: GPS run, ride, walk and hike tracker with Injury Guard training-load alerts, smart ring sleep data and GPX/FIT export.
apps.audience: Runners, cyclists and hikers who want to keep their training data without a subscription.
apps.priceModel: Free version; 7-day trial of everything, then a one-time purchase
apps.privacy: No account; workouts stay on the device.

apps.name: Minua: Earn Screen Time
apps.summary: Screen time you earn, for your child or for yourself: time in the apps you want more of unlocks the apps you want less of. Parent PIN mode for a child's device, Myself mode for adults.
apps.audience: Parents setting screen-time rules, and adults breaking their own scroll habit.
apps.privacy: Fully on the device, no accounts.

apps.name: Bellgrave — 3D Roguelike RPG
apps.summary: Dark 3D roguelike horde-survivor: draft an arsenal of up to four weapons, evolve them from boss treasure, dodge telegraphed attacks, face multi-phase bosses across cursed realms. Touch or game controller.
apps.audience: Action and roguelike fans who want a premium game with no ads or timers.
apps.priceModel: Free download; a one-time purchase unlocks the full game
apps.privacy: No ads, no account; progress stays on the device.

apps.name: Card Bash: Roguelike Deck RPG
apps.summary: Roguelike deck RPG with 200+ neon creature cards, tactical turn-based fights, a booster to open every 24 hours, daily quests, duels with a friend nearby over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth and trades through Messages.
apps.audience: Card-battler and roguelike players on iPhone and iPad.
apps.priceModel: Free to play; optional in-app purchases
apps.privacy: No ads; game progress stays on the device.

apps.name: Merge Bash: Idle Monster Game
apps.summary: Idle merge-to-evolve creature collector: merge Beasts from Common to Mythic, haggle with league patrons, send expeditions, climb nine leagues and face the Tide League's champion in Champion Clash. Idle earnings while you are away.
apps.audience: Players who like idle and merge games.
apps.priceModel: Free to play; optional in-app purchases
apps.privacy: No ads; progress stays on the device.

apps.name: Inkla: Handwriting Practice
apps.summary: Handwriting practice for kids in 8 languages (English, French, German, Spanish, Romanian, Japanese hiragana, Chinese, Hindi): letter formation with feedback after every attempt, print and cursive, Word Explorer and Meaning Quiz.
apps.audience: Children learning to write and the adults teaching them.
apps.priceModel: 7-day free trial, then a one-time purchase

apps.name: Keystrike: Piano Sight Reading
apps.summary: Piano lessons: graded course from Grade 0 to Grade 8, sight-reading, ear training, built-in pieces as engraved sheet music or falling notes, MIDI keyboard or on-screen piano, MIDI import.
apps.audience: Beginners, returning players and self-taught learners who want a structured path.
apps.priceModel: 3-day free trial, then a one-time purchase
apps.privacy: No account, no ads, no tracking; progress and recordings stay on the device.

apps.name: Custoda: Expiry Tracker
apps.summary: Pantry, expiry and allergen tracker: scan to track expiry dates, allergen and diet warnings that say "unverified" when data is missing, recipes ranked by what you have, a household shopping list and dinner vote via private iCloud invitations, replace-by dates for smoke alarms and first-aid kits.
apps.audience: Households that want to waste less food and stay safe with allergens.
apps.priceModel: Free version; 7-day trial of everything, then a one-time purchase
apps.privacy: No account; data stays on the device, and barcode lookups send only the barcode number.

apps.name: Fare Wars
apps.summary: Arcade bus racing through Rivergate: race rival buses for every fare, boss races, a garage of restored buses and a paint shop.
apps.audience: Arcade racing fans on iPhone and iPad.
apps.priceModel: Free to play; everything can be earned by playing, with optional purchases
apps.privacy: No ads; progress stays on the device.

apps.name: Zoombot: Robot Running Game
apps.summary: Jetpack runner across a city of rooftops: outrun patrols, beat bosses, rescue your crew and build your own robot in the Workshop.
apps.audience: Endless-runner fans on iPhone and iPad.
apps.priceModel: Free to play; optional in-app purchases
apps.privacy: No ads; progress stays on the device.
